statement: The partition HLC is monotonic across leadership change and process restart: applying any committed Raft entry advances the applying replica's HLC to at least that entry's HLC, and a restarted node never emits an HLC below one it previously committed, so a causally-later write for any key always receives a strictly higher HLC than an earlier write even across leader handoff. Proven by deterministic tests plus a green suite.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
